title: The Crusaders Volume 12: Alberto Comic Book by J.T.C.
descriptionText: The Crusaders Volume 12: Alberto Comic Book by J.T.C. is a single issue comic book featuring the character Alberto from the religious series The Crusaders. Published by Chick Publications, this US comic follows a tradition of faith-based storytelling within the genre of religious comics. With a grade of 5.5 Fine-, this collectible comic book offers readers a glimpse into the world of faith and adventure through the illustrated tales of Alberto and his companions on a spiritual journey.
